# CityRock POS

> High-performance cloud point-of-sale and multi-store inventory management platform for retail businesses.

CityRock POS is an all-in-one retail management system built with Next.js and Express/MongoDB. It empowers retail shops, boutiques, grocery stores, and multi-branch chains to operate seamlessly online and offline.

## Core Capabilities
- Offline POS Cashier terminal with barcode scanner support (USB HID) and ESC/POS thermal receipt printing (80mm & 58mm).
- Multi-store inventory sync with low-stock alerts, reorder thresholds, and variant SKU management (size, color).
- Double-entry transaction history with automated PDF invoice and Excel export.
- Role-Based Access Control: Super Admin, Platform Admin, Store Owner, Store Manager, and Cashier.
- Multi-channel payment proof verification via direct bank transfer and mobile wallets (JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay).
